# Catalyze Care

> Catalyze Care is a healthcare marketing agency for therapy practices, psychiatry clinics, and multi-location specialty groups. We help practices get more patients from the doctors who already refer in their market, then add SEO and paid ads on the same plan, at published prices.

Key facts
- Services: healthcare referral marketing (flagship), SEO for healthcare practices, paid ads (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Display) for healthcare practices.
- Published prices: referral marketing $5,000/month with a 3-month minimum; SEO $799/month with a 6-month minimum; paid ads management $2,500/month plus media, with a 3-month minimum.
- Who we work with: therapy practices, psychiatry clinics, multi-location mental health groups, and other specialty practices and provider groups in the US.
- Referral outreach channels: fax, email, phone, LinkedIn, and direct mail to offices that already refer in your specialty.
- Reporting: monthly, tied to booked appointments from your intake, not clicks.
- Client results are published only with the client’s written permission.
- Pricing: https://catalyzegrowth.co/pricing
- Content feed (JSON Feed, every live page and post with its last update): https://catalyzegrowth.co/feed.json
- Contact: andrew@catalyzegrowth.co. Book a demo: https://catalyzegrowth.co/#contact

## Start here: our five main pages
- Healthcare marketing agency: https://catalyzegrowth.co/healthcare-marketing-agency
  How we run referral marketing, SEO, and paid ads on one plan for therapy practices, psychiatry clinics, and multi-location provider groups. Fees: $5,000 / $799 / $2,500 a month.
- Healthcare referral marketing: https://catalyzegrowth.co/healthcare-referral-marketing
  You get claims-backed outreach to the offices already sending patients in your specialty, by fax, email, phone, LinkedIn, and direct mail. $5,000/month, 3-month minimum.
- SEO for healthcare practices: https://catalyzegrowth.co/seo-for-healthcare-practices
  Google Business Profile, citations, on-page and technical fixes, schema, and new content for your specialty so patients find you by specialty and location. $799/month, 6-month minimum.
- Paid ads for healthcare practices: https://catalyzegrowth.co/paid-ads-for-healthcare-practices
  HIPAA-aware Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Display aimed at booked appointments, with no targeting by condition. $2,500/month management plus media, 3-month minimum.
- Healthcare digital marketing: https://catalyzegrowth.co/healthcare-digital-marketing
  SEO, paid ads, and referral outreach run as one system, with one specialty map and one monthly report you can check against your intake. Each channel keeps its own published fee: $5,000 / $799 / $2,500 a month.
